## GEOGRAPHY closed point set difference
# Source: https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions#st_difference
# Results follow the documented closure of the point set difference. ST_EQUALS avoids relying
# on component and vertex ordering. The polygon with a hole is the documentation's example.

SELECT ST_DIFFERENCE(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT TYPEOF(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0)))
=> "GEOGRAPHY"

SELECT ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY')), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4)), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 1 1, 2 2)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 2 2)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)')))
=> "true"

# Removing a lower-dimensional subset leaves the closure unchanged.
SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0)), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 -1, 1 1)')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 3 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 4 0)')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 3 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 2 0)')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 1 0), (2 0, 3 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)')))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 4 0)')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0))')))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 10 10, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((4 2, 6 2, 8 6, 4 2))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 10 10, 0 0), (8 6, 6 2, 4 2, 8 6))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((2 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 2, 2 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(9 9), LINESTRING(0 0, 3 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(9 9), LINESTRING(1 0, 2 0))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 1 0), (2 0, 3 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe')))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0))')), ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0)')]))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(SAFE.ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4)), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "true"

SELECT IF(FALSE, ST_DIFFERENCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 100), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0)), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "POINT(0 0)"
